description: This file provides utility functions for handling access and refresh tokens in local storage, including retrieval, storage, and removal, for authentication purposes within a web application.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored access token from local storage used for authorization headers.

methods.name: getRefreshToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored refresh token from local storage used for token rotation.

methods.name: setTokens
methods.description: Stores provided access and/or refresh tokens into local storage.

methods.name: clearTokens
methods.description: Removes stored access and refresh tokens, typically used during logout or upon receiving unauthorized responses.

methods.name: hasAnyToken
methods.description: Returns true if at least one token (access or refresh) is stored in local storage.
